turns.text: Hey Lloyd, did you get that software license renewal email?
Yes, I did. It's due next week. Do you want me to draft a payment confirmation?
No, I'll handle it manually. I don't trust auto-pay for this one. By the way, I'm rethinking how we handle tool selection in the new agent config.
Understood. Are you considering switching to a semantic search model for better context awareness?
Absolutely not. Keyword matching is preferred over semantic/embedding routing for tool selection. It's too unpredictable otherwise.
Got it. I'll keep that constraint in mind for any future architecture discussions.
Good. Also, check if the coffee maker is still in stock.
It is back in stock. Shall I add it to your cart?
